Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR replaces filename-based Linux process-owner admission with runtime identity and startup-hook detection, sharing the existing Node option parser. **Example:** A Linux Bun process executes a TypeScript process helper without startup hooks. - **Before:** Admission rejects the helper because its source URL ends in .ts. - **After:** Admission proceeds to kernel ownership verification and the existing child checks. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The focused patch has no actionable findings and passing exact-head CI; behavioral evidence remains limited to admission tests and a classification probe. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; its supplied evidence covers mocked admission and a Node/Bun/AOT classification probe, rather than a shipped managed-command run. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Managed Linux commands can reject a helper that executes TypeScript natively or retains TypeScript source identity after compilation. **Reason:** Runtime capability is a more accurate admission criterion than source filenames, and the maintainer-authored direction preserves the independent-reaper restriction. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this PR open: current main still rejects loader-free TypeScript helpers, and the focused change preserves kernel ownership checks without introducing a concrete correctness defect. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The supplied classification probe does not demonstrate managed-command launch and descendant reaping through the shipped helper.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The process supervisor admits a dedicated Linux helper before launching managed commands; runtime identity and startup options determine admission, while kernel wait ownership controls descendant signaling and reaping. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Managed command] --> B[Process supervisor] B --> C[Dedicated Linux helper] D[Runtime identity and startup options] --> E[Source loader classification] E --> C C --> F[Kernel ownership verification] F --> G[Launch and reap descendants] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Use the existing runtime identity owner and shared startup-hook parser while retaining dedicated kernel wait ownership. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current main's unconditional TypeScript-extension guard establishes the rejection path; the supplied regression reports red on the original guard and green after replacement, but no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change uses existing owners, preserves the parser's behavior, removes the superseded implementation, and retains the kernel checks that motivated the original restriction. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [f6ded3229891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6ded3229891a04a1e31d949da9a51bf8f03449b). ### Provenance checked - `Linux process-owner admission` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (2aed86671065f0f73cf78032dcecc95e287dda09: Dedicated child-wait ownership prevents an independent loader reaper from invalidating PID pinning before signals.) - `Node option parsing` keeps the original intent (88c684c13efebb6106f75ddee18a3103921d86c9: Preserve Node's quoting grammar so resolver hooks and managed-service heap options are interpreted correctly.) - `Vitest worker-cache loader exclusion` keeps the original intent (8b2c9fbcc8bff20a9ed9e87d020eaa7639a56a84: Custom loaders can alter emitted code independently of cached source bytes.) ### Testing Proof path: unit tests only. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current main retains the reported failure:** The fetched main revision still rejects every .ts, .cts, or .mts source URL before attempting kernel admission. ([`src/process/supervisor/linux-child-subreaper.ts:37`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f6ded3229891a04a1e31d949da9a51bf8f03449b/src/process/supervisor/linux-child-subreaper.ts#L37), [f6ded3229891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6ded3229891a04a1e31d949da9a51bf8f03449b)) - **Introduced change and retained safeguards:** The pinned introduction replaces the filename guard; platform admission, subreaper verification, existing-child rejection, synchronous wait ownership before signaling, and ECHILD-based extinction remain intact. ([`src/process/supervisor/linux-child-subreaper.ts:38`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54/src/process/supervisor/linux-child-subreaper.ts#L38), [d74819bd3ef3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54)) - **Original ownership rationale:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160465 established dedicated wait ownership because a loader's independent reaper can invalidate PID pinning; this PR retains that restriction while replacing its filename proxy. ([`src/process/supervisor/linux-child-subreaper.ts:64`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2aed86671065f0f73cf78032dcecc95e287dda09/src/process/supervisor/linux-child-subreaper.ts#L64), [2aed86671065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2aed86671065f0f73cf78032dcecc95e287dda09)) - **Parser provenance and complete cutover:** The parser introduced by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/128663 moves without algorithm changes; daemon, diagnostic, and worker-cache callers use the shared module, and the obsolete module and wrapper entry are removed. ([`node-runtime-env.mjs:5`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54/node-runtime-env.mjs#L5), [d74819bd3ef3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54)) - **Accepted startup-hook restriction:** The maintainer-authored direction explicitly excludes startup hooks that can install a separate compiler or reaper; the implementation also rejects such hooks for loose built helpers that previously passed the filename guard. ([`cli-invocation.mjs:109`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54/cli-invocation.mjs#L109), [d74819bd3ef3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54)) - **Exact-head CI:** The current-head openclaw/ci-gate succeeded; paginated checks showed cancelled automation jobs but no failing product checks. ([d74819bd3ef3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d74819bd3ef35c61611c5e786d386261bec97d54)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 3bfccdb9bd3df459931e9d6f8751acfc9f147dfa adds cli-invocation.mjs:62 relative to its recorded parents.
